limitations: I checked against full-327.png and all 8 crops (detail1 to detail4, right and left). At this resolution some fine marks can't be confirmed on their own. Wherever a human has ruled, I followed that ruling. I didn't add or remove any mark by analogy.
The dot inside pe and final pe (for example אִכַּף, נִכַּף, אַף, סְפוֹרוֹת, וּשְׁפַל) is treated as part of the letter shape, not as a dagesh. This follows the standing convention.

Two marks are treated as print or scan artifacts, not text: the small mark above the gap between לֹא and עֲבַדְתִּֽיךָ on L25, and the dotted streak running down from L24 toward L25. Human 534 already settled what is recited in חִיַּֽבְתָּ.
